newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech Komercni hit hard by poor results.
newsitem.headline: Czech Komercni hit hard by poor results.

text.p: Shares in Czech Komercni Banka continued to fall at the beginning of the Prague Stock Exchange's continuous trading session, hit hard by disappointing nine-month results.
Komercni shares were trading at 1,999 crowns at 1115 GMT, down 146 crowns on the session, but up slightly from their low earlier in the session of 1,980.
Though the bank has yet to officially release nine-month results, traders said their figures show heavier provisioning will hurt the bank's boottom line.

"The nine-month results according to our figures are lower than expected, and the market appears to be reacting to this," said Jan Sykora of Wood and Company. "I think provisioning will have to be larger than originally expected."
Komercni officials said they would release nine-month results on Friday.
Sykora did not elaborate on the brokerage's figures.
Other analysts added that the market's current downturn, which has seen the PSE lose over 10 percent in October, is also helping to push prices down across the board.
